name: Avenixr Simple Header Pop Up Builder
author: avenixr

sections.description:
Avenixr Simple Header Pop Up Builder lets site owners create a promotional header sale bar without custom code. It includes a live preview plus controls for sale text, main content, dynamic countdown timer, coupon text, background image, background color, linear gradient colors, and section text colors.

The plugin does not use external services, does not track visitors, and does not add front-end credit links.

Features

  • Enable or disable the popup from the admin.
  • Edit sale text, main content, repeating timer duration, and coupon text.
  • Let visitors copy the coupon code or apply it directly to a WooCommerce cart.
  • Choose between two sale bar designs.
  • Show the popup at the top or bottom of the screen.
  • Choose a background image, background color, linear gradient colors, and separate text colors for the sale, main content, timer, and coupon.
  • Add an optional display delay.
  • Let visitors dismiss the popup.
  • Show the popup again once after a timed close delay, then keep it hidden for the browser session.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the avenixr-simple-header-pop-up-builder folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Header Pop Up > Design to build the popup or bar.
  4. Go to Header Pop Up > Settings to control visibility and behavior.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin track visitors?

No. The plugin does not send data to any third-party service. Close behavior is stored in the visitor’s browser session storage.

Can I add links in the message?

Yes. The message field allows basic safe HTML such as links and emphasis.

Will it work with any theme?

The popup is designed to work with most WordPress themes. Theme CSS with very high z-index values may require small style adjustments.
